column1: # Real gutenberg.org book pages (/ebooks/<number>), unedited, and each book's
# page that holds the whole book, and so its chapter list.
# Fetched directly from the site, one request every 3s, 2026-10-12: twenty
# chosen books (Moby Dick, War and Peace, Hamlet, Leaves of Grass, The Gift
# of the Magi, Les Misérables, Don Quijote, ...) and the rest a seeded random
# draw from the site's offline catalogue (Type = Text), in whatever language
# it fell on. 125 were captured; the eighteen largest random draws were left
# out for size, and four more books answered 504 and were not retried.
# `chapters` is measured by bs4 + html5lib code that restates, independently,
# the split rule in Gutenberg.kt (see `layout`) — not by the app.
